reason: Mitra being free in the pilot doesn't really matter. What I'd actually be risking is ₹5,000 paid to a creator, and Meta boosts already get me reach I can predict. Most of these creators look like bought followers to me, and 'Self-reported' numbers are exactly what I don't trust.
objection: How do I know the followers are real and from my area? A promo code that only gets counted when my staff remember to tap +1 won't show me much, and I'd still be out the creator's fee.
would_change_my_mind: Every matched creator Verified, with proof their audience is local to my area, plus a past deal from a salon or gym like mine showing real customers who came in.
